bio: The tastefully modern restaurant of Neckartal business hotel is run with dedication. The regional cuisine draws on international influences and is made using top-notch seasonal produce. In addition to the menu, there are also daily specials presented verbally. Owner Bernd Nödinger brings not only professional competence but also a friendly and personal touch to the service. The beverage recommendations are also spot on – thanks to the Coravin system, you can even enjoy high-quality wines by the glass. There is a delightful terrace in summer, and that space gives way to the Tafelhütte event venue in winter. The restaurant is open for lunch on Wednesdays and Thursdays – please book in advance. Reservations for Sundays and Mondays are possible by prior arrangement....
